collared-neck.head: neckline_type
collared-neck.description: Derive collared-neck from spatially associated Category 28 collar parts, preferring shirt (163) or polo (164) collars, rejecting conflicting necklines.

cap-length.head: sleeve_length
cap-length.description: Derive cap-length from sleeve-part Attribute 207 cap (sleeve), rejecting conflicting sleeve-lengths.

none.head: sleeve_style
none.description: Derive sleeve_style none strictly when sleeve_length is sleeveless with direct or human-verified provenance.

regular-sleeve.head: sleeve_style
regular-sleeve.description: Derive regular-sleeve from sleeve-part Attribute 204 set-in sleeve when no special sleeve-style attributes are present.

flutter-sleeve.head: sleeve_style
flutter-sleeve.description: Derive flutter-sleeve from sleeve-part Attribute 211 circular flounce (sleeve) without conflicting special sleeve-styles.
